Hi Neha / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team liked the latency profiles and the model routing demo. We ran the numbers this morning and want to move faster, but we need more breathing room on unit pricing to commit to a 12-month usage commitment.

Our CFO is asking if Redwood can provide a 25% off list rate on Hosted API usage for an initial 12-month $1.2M commit, with quarterly usage reviews and the option to convert to Dedicated after Q2 if usage justifies it.

Key asks from our side:
- 25% discount on usage rates for the 12-month term
- Standard data controls (SOC2 attestation and IP carve-outs) — we already have the security questionnaire in progress
- A simple mutual action plan with milestones and penalties removed for under-usage in Q1 for ramp risk

I've attached the draft SOW and a high-level usage projection. Can Redwood escalate this for executive approval? We can sign quickly if terms are acceptable.

Thanks,
Emily

Head of Data Partnerships
Sentinel Health

Ben / Marcus —

FYI: Sentinel is pushing for a 25% off list on Hosted API for a $1.2M, 12-month commit. They view this as strategic (healthcare analytics partner) and plan to convert to Dedicated if Q2 ramps.

Why I'm escalating:
- 25% is beyond standard dealdesk guardrails for this product (our threshold is 20% for standard approvals)
- Upside: $1.2M committed ARR, potential Dedicated conversion (higher LTV), referenceable enterprise logo in healthcare
- Risk: Compressed unit economics in H1 and potential early churn if their ramp stalls

Attached: my quick usage analysis (Q1 ramp assumptions) and the SOW they sent. Suggested ask: exec approval for a 25% off hosted usage rate with the following conditions:
- Commit $1.2M billed monthly/quarterly (prefer quarterly)
- 90-day ramp protection: no early termination fees if usage <50% of plan in Q1, but require a ramp review and revised forecast
- Add a $50k implementation professional services fee to cover onboarding and dedicated SE time

If approved, I will negotiate contract language to preserve our standard IP and security terms.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Forwarding the thread and attachments from Sentinel. Short summary and recommendation below.

Opportunity:
- Sentinel Health: healthcare analytics platform with 120M annual API calls projected at scale. They are prepared to commit $1.2M in hosted usage for 12 months and may convert to Dedicated by Q3 if performance & price align.

Requested concession:
- 25% off Hosted API usage rates for the 12-month term (above our 20% dealdesk limit).

Commercial rationale / upside:
- Immediate ARR of $1.2M; conservative retention assumption yields $2.8M 36-month NRR if they convert to Dedicated later
- High strategic value in healthcare, good reference potential for payers/providers
- Opportunity to profile our cache/batching benefits at scale and solicit joint case study

Risk mitigation (recommended conditions):
1) Quarterly billing with a minimum first quarter invoice of $200k to de-risk ramp
2) Add $50k one-time onboarding/pro-services to cover SE time and fast-track integration
3) Standard security addenda (SOC2 + data processing terms) signed before go-live
4) 30-day executive rollback clause if usage deviates >60% from forecast after Q2 review

Attachments included: SENTINEL_MAPP_SOW.pdf, usage_analysis_Q1.csv, approval_matrix.xlsx

Ask: Please advise if you can approve the 25% concession under those conditions. If you prefer a counter, my recommended counter is 22% + $50k PS + quarterly billing.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference

After reviewing the ask and the upside, I approve a 25% off Hosted API usage rate for the Sentinel Health 12-month $1.2M commit under the following firm conditions:

1) 22% approved for signature immediately; 25% conditional on receipt of the $50k onboarding fee and a minimum first-quarter invoice of $200k. If those conditions are met by execution, finance will retroactively apply the additional 3% to the contract from day one.
